content: vstest.console.exe ran both existing Akari test assemblies in ONE invocation against the already-built bin output with zero build: Total tests 230, Passed 229, NotExecuted 1, 'Test Run Successful.' Per-assembly from TRX testName prefixes: AkariTool.Core.Tests 93, AkariTool.Infrastructure.Tests 137 (so AGENTS.md's 53+136 and TESTING.md's Core 53 / Infra 136+1 are both stale). The single non-passing test is AkariTool.Infrastructure.Tests.Services.UpdateServiceTests.CheckAsync_LiveCall_NotRunInUnitTests. The TRX logger (/logger:trx;LogFileName=... /ResultsDirectory:...) writes a Counters element carrying total, executed, passed, failed, notExecuted attributes, which is the machine-readable seam for the D-12 test count. MSBuild 18.10 exposes -clp via -consoleloggerparameters, -warnaserror, -bl, -getProperty, -getTargetResult, -fileLogger and -t:Rebuild. Process is elevated so the suite can run. Do NOT count dll files in bin to inventory assemblies: App's win-x64 self-contained output holds 224 dll/exe because of the bundled WindowsAppSDK payload; the project assemblies are 6 (AkariTool.Core, AkariTool.Infrastructure, WinGet.Interop, WinUI.Framework, AkariTool.dll, AkariTool.exe) plus 2 test dlls.
